steps.content: Senior Management Office, Drifter Camp
At the broadcasting station, the lanky leader is concentrated on watching various monitors and operating the mechanisms carefully to help fence off Corruptors for those who remain.
He's still repeating the announcement, time after time.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has launched the evacuation procedures. All inhabitants please follow Rustfire members to the shelters.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Keep calm. Stay rational. Support each other. We've overcome countless hardships before, and we'll do it again this time. I repeat...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I repeat. The Drifter Camp has launched...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Julien?!
The shout from another terminal interrupts him. Unbothered, Julien turns down the volume and finishes his camp-wide announcement before he reconnects Taran's communication.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Why haven't you left yet?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Evacuation is mostly done. You'll only increase the risk of unnecessary casualties if you linger. I've ordered the entire crew of Rustfire to leave. Do you want to create more trouble again?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: That's my question too. The entire crew of Rustfire must leave. Then what are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: There are things I must see to.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Then I'll stay. It's my job to protect our leader. As a member of Rustfire, how can I abandon my companion to save my own life?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You still have over forty thousand companions in the shelters. If you die here, who will protect them?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Then what about you? Does your life not matter?

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: My life will only matter if I die.
He doesn't hesitate to answer.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Even if it's the wisest decision to give this place up, the fact that I've abandoned my companions will be engraved in everyone's memories.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: <size=32>From then on, Rustfire members will doubt themselves, and the weaker ones will have an excuse to fall into depravity. Within Drifter Camp, within our foundation, everyone will see us as cowardly traitors. If we lose their support, we lose everything.</size>

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: But you have a reason. It's all for the sake of Drifter Camp. People will understand.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: They won't. People never listen to reason, that's why conspirators can incite conflict so easily.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But that can be easily resolved, as long as the one who made that decision stays.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: As long as I die here, this humiliating decision will turn into a grand sacrifice, a public demonstration of Rustfire's belief. This belief will be passed on to you guys, and you will win everyone's recognition.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You guys will gain unprecedented support and face the real battle.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: What... are you talking about...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: You've said the real battle will only come after this, that we must burn Syndicate down and take back everything that belonged to us. You must lead us. You're our leader!

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...I'm no leader, and I haven't seen one since.
He produces a bomb. Hypercubes' blue light flickers in the gaps of the intricate structure, sending out dangerous signals.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Black Ring is bound to erupt, and I'll stay and find a chance to weaken that thing. After that, those people from Minos will come back to destroy this monster.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: By that time, both the Black Rings here and the Inner Bay one will be resolved. Rustfire must take them over at all costs. Everything we need is there.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Taran, you have the most battle experience and the most courage. You got the burning passion and what it takes to rally people's hearts. But that is far from enough.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Because you couldn't control your temper, Rustfire had misjudged ${PlayerName} and delayed our cooperation. Myself included, everyone here died because of your willfulness.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Remember this, and take responsibility for these lives. Learn to be patient and calm, control your anger, for your dream and everyone behind you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: There is no one left to lead Rustfire forward except you.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...What do you mean? What about the elite squad? Didn't you say Captain and the others are still...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Raven is still waiting for you in the shelter. Meet her there. She'll tell you everything.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: This is my last order.
Julien cuts off the call and goes back to the broadcasting station.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has launched the evacuation procedures. All inhabitants please follow Rustfire members to the shelters.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Keep calm. Stay rational. Support each other. We've overcome countless hardships before, and we'll do it again this time. I repeat...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Those who can't push forward anymore can stay. Both I and Drifter Camp will be here with you till the end.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: But never forget: This is not the end. Whatever is destroyed will be reforged. Whoever is trampled will be honored again. Don't go into death with despair. That's not why you came here in the first place. That's not what the Drifter Camp exists for.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Remember, we were just not around to see the daybreak, but someone... will light our flame.

Those are his last words. He opens up the secret mechanism and enters the passcode. With a spin of cogs, the hidden slot opens to reveal several anti-Mania bombs inside. He invented these specifically for that thing.
He watches the pale blue light, the long-repressed vengeance awakening in him.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: There are three things I loathe. The first is the vile city-state, the second is the shameless traitors, and the third... is the monster who killed all my companions and destroyed all our hopes.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: What a fine day it is. I can get rid of two of my nemeses at once and lay the path for the others, Rustfire will settle my final revenge.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'm eight years late, but I can finally step onto the same battlefield with you guys...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: I'll find it... Even if it means dying together with it...
Clank!

The door is blasted open. The man stands in the doorway. He's not wearing that cloak that conceals his identity. The gray jacket covering his head protects him from the crumbling debris, but he still looks somewhat clumsy.
steps.female_content: The door is blasted open. The woman stands in the doorway. She's not wearing that cloak that conceals her identity. The gray jacket covering her head protects her from the crumbling debris, but she still looks somewhat clumsy.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...It's you?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Stop standing around. Get inside! They're coming after us!
